repo_role: FMG is the canonical semantic control plane and Innovation OS contract repository.
governing_questions: What is canonical document structure here?
What is derived evidence or retrieval output here?
What AI control-plane rule applies here?
What policy or governance surface controls it?
What action or runtime surface depends on it?
What evidence and review path are required before promotion?

artifact_order.semantic_meaning: ontology, taxonomy, and shape-backed semantic authority
artifact_order.canonical_document_family: document, source-artifact, document-version, canonical-text, component, span-selector, and citation surfaces
artifact_order.derived_document_and_evidence: chunk, embedding, index, answer, and retrieval-support artifacts rebuilt from canonical structure
artifact_order.retrieval_and_access: derived request, trace, response, and access-control contracts
artifact_order.ai_control_plane: tool-neutral AI contributor governance, change-packet rules, deterministic gates, and adapter boundaries
artifact_order.policy_and_governance: registries, doctrine, lifecycle, access, and promotion controls
artifact_order.action_and_runtime: exceptions, pressure, opportunity, validation, sprint, pilot, scale, and related operating objects

canonical_boundary_role: Canonical meaning, canonical document structure, and draft Gold Standard KM designation must remain distinct from derived retrieval, answer, telemetry, vendor-local adapter outputs, and AI control-plane instructions.
non_negotiables: No canonical change without reviewed promotion decision
No retrieval or answer artifact may redefine canonical document boundaries
No vendor adapter may define canonical semantics locally
No AI adapter may outrank source-of-truth or design authority
No grounded answer without exact canonical span traceability
No access-sensitive retrieval without deny-by-default policy enforcement
No Gold Standard asset without canonical document, span, provenance, and policy anchors
No registry or doctrine drift that contradicts source-of-truth precedence
